translations.web: The priest shall take cedar wood, hyssop, and scarlet, and cast it into the middle of the burning of the heifer.
translations.bsb: The priest is to take cedar wood, hyssop, and scarlet wool and throw them onto the burning heifer.
translations.kjv: And the priest shall take cedar wood, and hyssop, and scarlet, and cast it into the midst of the burning of the heifer.
translations.asv: and the priest shall take cedar-wood, and hyssop, and scarlet, and cast it into the midst of the burning of the heifer.
